title: Team dynamics
learning_outcomes: Explain team purpose in the context of team dynamics.
Compare and distinguish role clarity in the context of team dynamics.
Apply psychological safety in the context of team dynamics.
Evaluate and justify decisions about feedback in the context of team dynamics.

lessons.title: Team purpose
lessons.outcome: Explain team purpose in the context of team dynamics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving team purpose; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to team charter.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain team purpose from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of team purpose; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Role clarity
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish role clarity in the context of team dynamics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving role clarity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to team charter.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain role clarity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of role clarity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Psychological safety
lessons.outcome: Apply psychological safety in the context of team dynamics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving psychological safety; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to team charter.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain psychological safety from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of psychological safety; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Feedback
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about feedback in the context of team dynamics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving feedback; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to team charter.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain feedback from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of team purpose; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of role clarity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of psychological safety; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
